fact: As at July 2026 no AI-specific legislation has been enacted in Zimbabwe; the National AI Strategy 2026-2030 was launched in March 2026 and the Supreme Court in 2025 nullified filings containing twelve AI-fabricated citations (Pulserate Investments v Andrew Zuze).
